title: Sky City Duel
styleReference: Premium cinematic anime: dramatic cel shading, atmospheric perspective over clouds, rich red-gold contrast, impact frames, speed ramps. No narration, no subtitles, no logos.

cast.name: Kuro
cast.reference: Silver-haired swordsman, long black coat with glowing crimson markings, katana forged from dark energy.

cast.name: Seren
cast.reference: Female warrior, flowing white hair, golden eyes, elegant black-and-gold armor, a pair of luminous celestial blades.

scenes.title: The Sky City
scenes.logline: Above the clouds a shattered futuristic city floats in a lightning storm; Kuro and Seren face each other on a cracked platform as wind tears at coat and hair and their auras flare.
scenes.props: katana of dark energy; twin celestial blades; storm clouds; lightning; wind in the coat and hair; aura glow

scenes.title: First Strike
scenes.logline: Kuro vanishes in a burst of crimson and reappears behind Seren with a horizontal slash; she blocks with both blades and the clash of sparks sends a shockwave that shatters the platform.
scenes.props: katana; twin blades crossed to block; sparks; shockwave; platform shatters into falling stone

scenes.title: Among the Ruins
scenes.logline: They leap between floating ruins trading lightning-fast strikes, an aerial kick, a spinning attack and a midair counter, every clash knocking stone into the clouds.
scenes.props: katana; twin blades; jump and land between ruins; kick; spinning strike; parry; falling stone fragments; wind

scenes.title: Celestial Barrage
scenes.logline: Seren spreads golden spectral wings and launches dozens of floating energy swords; Kuro sprints across collapsing structures deflecting them, then channels crimson lightning into a devastating circular slash.
scenes.props: golden wings; dozens of energy swords; deflect with the katana; sprint across collapsing bridges; crimson lightning; circular slash shockwave

scenes.title: Dragon and Phoenix
scenes.logline: Both charge their ultimates: Kuro summons a crimson dragon of shadow and lightning, Seren a radiant golden phoenix ringed with burning celestial rings, and they collide above the city in an explosion of red and gold that lights the whole sky.
scenes.props: crimson dragon of lightning; golden phoenix; burning rings; collision explosion; the sky lights red and gold

scenes.title: The Last Clash
scenes.logline: As the light fades both warriors descend onto opposite sides of the ruined platform, exhausted, weapons glowing faintly; a close-up of their eyes, a sudden rush toward each other, and a brilliant white flash.
scenes.props: katana glowing faintly; twin blades glowing faintly; wind; dust; descend and land; final dash; white flash
